title: Kepler to Müller, 16/26 January 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
source: Johannes Kepler's letter to Philipp Müller written at Sagan on 16/26 January 1630, about paper for his press, the printing of the Jesuit Terrentius's letter from China with his commentary, and the start of work on the *Ephemerides*. The original is lost; the copy is in the Bibliothèque nationale, Paris (Nouv. acq. lat. 1635, fol. 96; 89, 8. N). First printed in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 72–73.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Kepler reports the arrival of paper from Prague, asks Müller to stop any further Leipzig paper beyond what is ordered, and says the printing of Terrentius's letter from China and of the first pages of the *Ephemerides* has begun.

notes.note: The *Epistolium* of the Jesuit Johann Terrentius from China (1630), which Kepler printed at Sagan with his commentary.
